items.source: Hashcode typically derives from the Segment.toString() representation so two Segments yield the same Segment.hashCode() if their Segment.toString() representation matches.

items.source: Renders to: <name> or <name> AS <name>.
items.translation: 渲染为：<name> 或 <name> AS <name>。

items.source: The representation is intended for debugging purposes and an approximation to the generated SQL. While it might work in the context of a specific dialect, you should not assume that the Segment.toString() representation works across multiple databases.
items.translation: 该表示形式旨在用于调试目的，并作为生成的 SQL 的近似值。虽然它可能在特定方言的上下文中有效，但您不应假设Segment.toString()表示形式可在多个数据库之间通用。

items.source: Equality is typically given if the Segment.toString() representation matches.
items.translation: 当 `Segment.toString()` 的表示形式匹配时，通常认为相等。
